## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Culturelle® Medical Advisory Board


Our Microbiome Medical Advisory Board reflects our commitment to leveraging clinical evidence to
deliver microbiome-targeted solutions for your patients. Made up of trusted health care
professionals who truly understand the vital role the microbiome plays in overall wellness, the
Board helps guide our product innovation and clinical development with a focus on rigorous safety
standards and clinical efficacy. The Board is composed of health care professionals with extensive
clinical and research experience who provide strategic expertise across innovation, clinical
development, and medical education.

The Board supports the translation of emerging and established microbiome science into clinically
relevant solutions and contributes to the education of both health care providers and patients on
microbiome-targeted health solutions, with a focus on safety, scientific rigor, and clinical
relevance.

The Microbiome Medical Advisory Board is chaired by i-Health’s Global Scientific Engagement Leader,
Shavon Jackson-Michel, ND.

## Meet Our Board

#### Dr. Shavon Jackson-Michel

##### ND | Board Chair

Naturopathic Doctor and trained, biomedical engineer at the interface of product development,
clinical research and implementation science. Medical affairs and business development leader niched
in advancing researched, natural actives and botanical drugs across commercial pipelines and global
markets.

[ ** READ MORE ][22]

#### Dr. Vivian Asamoah

##### MD, FACG, IFMCP

John Hopkins fellowed and board-certified Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Nutrition expert.
IFM-certified Integrative Medicine practitioner. CEO of Houston Gastro Institute, practicing
physician, researcher, medical consultant, microbiome champion and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][23]

      

#### Dr. Jon Vanderhoof

##### MD

UCLA-fellowed Pediatric Gastroenterologist and researcher with 200+ publications. Chief of Pediatric
Gastroenterology at the Boystown NatResearch Center, attending at Boston Children’s and Senior
Lecturer at Harvard Medical School. Revered industry scientist, probiotics pioneer, and NASPGHAN
past president/awardee.

[ ** READ MORE ][24]

#### Dr. Whitney Casares

##### MD, MPH, FAAP

Stanford University and UC Berkely trained, board-certified Pediatrician and maternal and child
health Public Health specialist. A two-time American Academy of Pediatrics Author and Spokesperson,
private practice physician, consultant and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][25]

## Advisory Board Goals

#### Reinforced Credibility

Our brands have always held a credible standing – buoyed by our science and commitment to quality,
but this board will take this positioning to the next level, reinforcing and extending our reach not
only as a leader, but as an authority.

#### Expert Insights

Our Medical Advisory Board will provide key insights at a closer clip than ever! This fresh angle
will complement the advanced, metrics-driven, consumer-focused data that has always informed our
processes, innovations and positioning—supercharging our successes.

#### Thought Leadership

Holding brands with 20 and 30-year lifecycles, we know that success is a healthy combination of
courage, consistency and continuous evolution. Our boards boast 4x that in combined legacy &
experience, expanding the breadth of our excellence as an industry vanguard for decades to come.

#### Are you a healthcare Professional?

The information on this site is intended for healthcare professionals in the United States and is
not intended for the general public.

## Our Global Export Market

## Our Business

Apical Group is a leading vegetable oil processor with an expanding global footprint. Our vertically
integrated mid-stream refining and value-added downstream processing makes us an integral supplier
that supports the food, feed, oleochemicals and renewable fuel needs across industries.

Download our [brochures][51] to find our more about our products.

##### Oleochemicals

Our portfolio includes a wide range of oleochemicals such as fatty acid, soap noodles, glycerin, and
more.

##### Functional & Specialty Fats


We deliver a range of quality edible oils and its derivatives used by consumer goods manufacturers
globally for food and non-food applications.

##### Renewable Fuel

We produce biodiesel through the processing of palm oil at our facilities.

##### Circular Economy

### Our Products

Our vertically integrated operations allow us to produce a high standard of innovative products for
our customers. The benefits are competitive prices, consistent supply, product quality and
customised solutions.

[Explore our full product range][52]

### Responsible Sourcing & Production

For improved agricultural practices, we identify priority suppliers to engage with. We are also
committed to producing high quality palm oil products efficiently, safely and responsibly in our
internationally certified refineries.

[Find out more][53]

## Our Sustainability Approach

Sustainability is inherent to the way we think, act and operate. Responsible practices within our
operations and supply chain is essential for our long-term success as we head towards a circular
economy and 2030. Our approach is guided by our 5Cs business philosophy of doing what is good for
the community, country, climate, customer and only then will it be good for the company.

[Join us on our sustainability transformation journey][54]

## about us

### Company Overview

BioJiva is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company pioneering the development of first-in-class
therapeutics to treat degenerative diseases resulting from Lipid peroxidation (LPO). BioJiva has
developed a series of oxidation resistant armored Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFAs) as drug
interventions to mitigate LPO.

At the forefront of scientific innovation, our team specializes in lipid biology, natural lipid
peroxidation (LPO) process and its critical role in disease progression. Our first-in-class new
chemical entities (NCEs) are isotopically stabilized synthetic polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs)
designed to mitigate oxidative stress and cellular degeneration caused by LPO, thus addressing the
root causes of various degenerative conditions.

### Mission

With a team of world-class chemists, biologists and ophthalmology experts, we are uniquely equipped
to tackle degenerative eye diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Together, we
are committed to delivering transformative therapies that improve lives.

## Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) is a progressive eye disease and one of the leading causes of
vision loss worldwide, particularly in individuals over 50.

[ » learn more ][20]

Late stage age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) causes central blindness.

## product

### BRX011

BRX011 is BioJiva’s armored version of docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) which enables high visual acuity
and quick adjustment to dim lighting conditions by facilitating instant conformational changes of
the light-capturing pigment rhodopsin embedded in photoreceptor disc membranes. DHA is the most
enriched PUFA in mammalian retinas and extraordinarily susceptible to LPO. There is ample evidence
in the [literature][21] on how toxic oxidation/LPO products interact with complement risk variants
and promote the progression of AMD.

At BioJiva we are dedicated to transforming the landscape of AMD treatment using orally administered
BRX011.

### MOA - Mechanism of Action

Cells requiring high elasticity or rapid signal transduction, such as photoreceptors and neurons,
rely on polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs/lipids) in their membranes for optimal function. PUFAs
are also highly susceptible to oxidation and toxic lipid oxidation byproducts promote multiple
degenerative diseases. While vital for cellular performance, this duality underscores the delicate
balance between PUFA benefits and their oxidative risks. Ferroptosis, chronic inflammation, immune
over activation, and several other age-related molecular patterns (neuronal and retinal) emerge from
PUFA oxidation.

Is the Brave Browser safe?

Brave is one of the safest browsers on the market today. It blocks privacy-invasive ads & trackers.
It blocks third-party data storage. It protects from browser fingerprinting. It upgrades every

people worldwide. This source code is arguably vetted by more security researchers than any other
browser. In short, not only is Brave safe to use, it’s much safer than almost any other browser.
[Learn more][51].

How do I download & install Brave?

Brave is available on nearly all desktop computers (Windows, macOS, Linux) and nearly every mobile
device (Android and iOS). To get started, simply download the Brave browser [for desktop][52], [for
Android][53], or [for iOS][54].

Does Brave have a VPN?

Yes! [Brave Firewall + VPN][55] protects everything you do online, on your entire device, *even
outside the Brave Browser*. One subscription covers up to 5 devices, across Android, iOS, and
desktop.

Does Brave block YouTube ads?

Yes, the Brave browser can block ads on video sites like YouTube. That includes on-page ads,
pre-roll and mid-roll ads, end-card ads, and more. By blocking ads, you get a cleaner experience and
faster video load. [Learn more about Brave’s YouTube ad blocking.][56]

What is the Brave Search engine?

Brave Search is the private, independent search engine that’s default for most new users of the
Brave browser. It’s also [available in any other browser][57] at search.brave.com. Brave Search
serves fast, accurate results from its own independent index of the Web, and offers unique features
like a powerful AI-answer engine. Unlike some other search engines, Brave Search doesn’t profile
you; it can’t share, sell, or lose your personal data, because it’s not collected in the first
place. [Learn more about Brave Search.][58]

What languages is Brave available in?

The Brave Browser is available in nearly 160 languages in all, including four different dialects of
Chinese. Brave Search is currently available in almost 20 different languages, with support for even
more languages on the horizon.

independent, privately-held company. Brave is not beholden to any other tech company, and works
every single day to fight Big Tech’s terrible privacy abuses. Brave exists to help real people, not
some faceless tech company.

Yes. The Brave Browser is built on the open-source Chromium Web core and our own client code is
released under the [Mozilla Public License 2.0][59].

transporte.

# Equazen® is developed with you in mind

Equazen contains only high-quality ingredients sourced from sustainable fish and naturally sourced
primrose oil and borage oil. Our unique formulations provide balanced omega-3 and omega-6 to support
learning difficulties and brain function.

[Our Source to Patient philosophy ][23]

## The Equazen® difference

Discover what makes us different to other supplements.

[Science at the core]

### Science at the core

Everything we do is based on rigorous testing. We are continuously advancing our understanding of
essential fatty acids and how they work. Our products are clinically researched so we are confident
that we can pass on benefits to you.

[Explore our products ][24]
[Quality & Consistency]

### Quality & Consistency

The quality of supplements can vary based on the consistency of the ingredient used and the precise
care taken at each step of the production process. At Equazen®, quality and consistency is ensured
from sourcing all the way through to shipping.

[Why quality counts ][25]
[Tailored to you]

### Tailored to you

We know that essential fatty acids provide benefits for each phase of your life. That’s why we
produce specific formulations to meet the changing needs of each life stage.*****

[Our formulations ][26]

## Equazen® Chews

Easy and tasty way to support healthy brain development in children.

These include Isostearic Acid, Dimer Acid, Dimer Fatty Acid, and other specialty derivatives,

printing inks and industrial formulations.

Explore our journey, innovation capabilities, and commitment to shaping the future of specialty
chemicals in India.

meticulously crafted for diverse industries. As one of the trusted Chemical Manufacturing Companies
in India, we deliver performance-driven solutions that support the growing Oleochemical Industry in

Our commitment to excellence sets out the benchmark for innovation, sustainability, and product
reliability across specialty segments.

wellness and slow down oxidative stress. As one of the trusted Tocopherol Manufacturers in India, we
specialize in producing high-quality Natural Vitamin E ingredients for diverse applications.

Recognized among reliable Natural Vitamin E Manufacturers and experienced Vitamin E Manufacturers in
India, Fairchem supplies refined tocopherol concentrates to global nutraceutical and wellness
brands. Our expertise in Nutraceuticals Manufacturing ensures consistent purity, stability, and
performance across formulations.

As dependable Tocopherol Suppliers and a quality-driven Vitamin E Oil Manufacturer in India, we
support customers with sustainable, traceable, and regulatory-compliant solutions designed to
enhance health-focused product development.

Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

normal vision.

### High-Quality Palm Oil Production • Factory Supply • Global Export

# is your regional oleochemical supplier with a global reach

Our global network grants you access to oleochemical supplies, contract manufacturing, and
end-to-end solutions that help you improve your outcomes and reduce manufacturing costs.

CREMER has three North American facilities for oleochemical supply and manufacturing services
accessible throughout the United States and beyond. Extend your internal manufacturing capabilities
and drive growth with CREMER.
[CREMER NA has three locations in Ohio, Tennessee and Louisiana.]

# THE OLEOCHEMICAL SUPPLIER OF CHOICE

## End-To-End

CREMER serves manufacturers and clients with high volume product lines who want to expand their
existing product lines, warehouse, or manufacturing processes. For those looking for oleochemical
supply, our volumes range from a single drum to a barge, with options for volume and material state.

CREMER has the technical expertise and supply dependability you need to innovate on new products or
increase your capacity.

Contact us for a custom plan built for the needs of your product.
[ CONTACT US > ][54]

## Sustainable

CREMER oleochemicals are plant-based, sustainable and safe solutions for personal care, pet treats,
pharmaceuticals, manufacturing, and industrial purposes.
[ CONTACT US > ][55]

## Timely

Our three locations across the North American interior connect businesses with the manufacturing,
logistics, and global oleochemical supply solutions they need, when they need them. With flexible
capacity across our sites, many projects begin production within six weeks.
[ CONTACT US > ][56]

## Accessible

Our facilities supply and ship to anywhere in North America or across the globe with access to the
Gulf of Mexico, Ohio and Mississippi Rivers, and connections to South American industrial
oleochemical suppliers within the CREMER network of suppliers. Our North American experts have
experience in every part of the logistics matrix, including: import, air and ocean export, barge,
flatbed, truck, rail, transloading, warehousing, and tank storage.
[ CONTACT US > ][57]

## Quality

CREMER adheres to the highest standards of quality to ensure consistent, reliable solutions. In our
Cincinnati, Ohio, location, we hold the following certifications and are registered with the FDA for
food and excipient ingredients. Our Health and Safety page goes into detail on the certifications
for each location.

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

### PMC Biogenix

# Responsible Chemistry

PMC Biogenix is a global, innovation-driven developer, manufacturer and marketer of specialty
chemicals produced from renewable resources.

The combination of over fifty years of experience developing and manufacturing oleochemical
derivatives, dedication to innovation in new products and chemistries, and strong technical
application support create the foundation of a powerful portfolio of chemical products that find
applications in virtually every chemical end market.

Our products are marketed under our leading brand names such as [Armoslip^{®}][43],
[ADVALUBE^{®}][44], [ADVAWAX^{®}][45], [ADVAPAK^{®}][46], [Hystrene^{®}][47], [Industrene^{®}][48],
[Kemamide^{®}][49], [Kemester^{®}][50], [Kemstrene^{®}][51], [Lubrazinc^{®}][52] and
[Neustrene^{®}.][53]

The [Center for Renewable Chemistry][54], our 3.5 acre technical campus dedicated to renewable
products, provides unmatched product and application development and technical support to our
customers.

[ More About PMC Group ][55]

# Featured Industries


### Polymers & Plastics

Our custom solutions are unmatched in the polymers & plastics additives market. Our technical
support team is ready to assist you from concept development to product synthesis.

[ Learn More ][56]


### Lubricants & Greases

PMC Biogenix provides a wide range of chemistries for lubricant and fuel manufacturers from both
natural and petroleum technology platforms.

[ Learn More ][57]


### Metalworking

Our wide range of additives can be tailored to metal working applications in both ferrous and
non-ferrous environments to meet the most stringent requirements of our customers.

[Learn More][58]


### Chemical Manufacturing

PMC Biogenix produces base oleochemicals and their derivatives from natural, renewable sources for
the global chemical industry.

[Learn More][59]

### Pourquoi choisir Polaris ?

#### Innovation

Polaris est expert depuis plus de 20 années dans le domaine de la lipochimie ou de la chimie des
lipides. L’expertise et la passion de Polaris dans ce domaine en fait un spécialiste de renom, et
plus particulièrement dans le traitement et la transformation des acides gras polyinsaturés par des
procédés de synthèse respectueux de l’environnement.

La spécialisation de Polaris dans la lipochimie se traduit par une forte expertise dans :
* La synthèse enzymatique et la synthèse d’actifs
* Le traitement et la valorisation des lipides: acides gras polyinsaturés

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Les brevets][39]
* [Recherche et partenariats][40]

#### Expertise

Polaris est expert de premier rang au niveau mondial dans les lipides fonctionnels. La société est
spécialiste de la production, du développement et de la formulation des acides gras polyinsaturés et
notamment des Oméga-3. Ses équipes ont développé et mis sur le marché plusieurs innovations visant à
améliorer la qualité, la stabilité et la formulation d’[huiles à haute valeur nutritionnelle riches
en Oméga-3][41].

Polaris a notamment développé un brevet sur l’enrichissement naturel des huiles de poissons riches
en acides gras [Oméga-3 EPA][42] et [DHA][43], ainsi qu’une technique exclusive appelée «
[Qualitysilver®][44]» qui stabilise les huiles polyinsaturées, qu’elles soient d’origine marine ou
végétale. Afin de garantir des huiles de très haute qualité Polaris a également mis en place un
panel de testeur pour assurer à la gamme d’huiles des qualités organoleptiques incomparables.

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Qualitysilver®, la stabilité assurée][45]
* [Sensory][46][®][47][, la performance organoleptique][48]
* [Greensilver][49][®][50]

#### Engagement durable

L’OMS recommande à tous, des nourrissons aux personnes âgées de consommer 250 mg d’Omega-3 par jour
pour vivre en bonne santé. C’est pourquoi Polaris s’engage depuis des années pour préserver le
milieu marin en utilisant et valorisant les co-produits de la pêche (têtes de poissons).

Aujourd’hui pour mener à bien cette mission Polaris oriente le coeur de sa stratégie CER vers la
durabilité, en développant sa production d’[huiles de microalgues][51] naturellement riches en
Omega-3, ressource renouvelable et vegan.

customers with reliable supply, market expertise, and exceptional service regardless of market
conditions. 

We take pride in maintaining a robust global supply portfolio supported by multiple domestic and
international sourcing relationships, supply redundancies, and contingency plans. In an increasingly
dynamic world, our customers rely on us to navigate supply chain disruptions and deliver consistent
results.

strategically positioned inventory across **20 stocking locations throughout the United States and
Canada**, combined with best-in-class operations and logistics, we provide agile local solutions
that allow our customers to receive product when and where they need it.

## Global Resources. Local Solutions

****

As a distributor, importer, and trader of commodity chemicals, our mission is simple: provide
customers with reliable supply, market expertise, and exceptional service regardless of market
conditions. 

We take pride in maintaining a robust global supply portfolio supported by multiple domestic and
international sourcing relationships, supply redundancies, and contingency plans. In an increasingly
dynamic world, our customers rely on us to navigate supply chain disruptions and deliver consistent
results.

At the same time, we recognize that global supply is only part of the equation. Through
strategically positioned inventory across **20 stocking locations throughout the United States and
Canada**, combined with best-in-class operations and logistics, we provide agile local solutions
that allow our customers to receive product when and where they need it.

**. **


 


## Service is our specialty.

****

Our business is intentionally focused on a narrow product portfolio, with **oleochemicals
representing more than 90% of our business**. This disciplined approach allows us to develop deep
expertise in both the products we sell and the markets we serve. Rather than being generalists, we
strive to be trusted specialists and market experts.

Our goal is not simply to execute transactions. We seek to be a valued partner—helping customers
understand market dynamics, navigate volatility, manage risk, and make informed sourcing decisions.
We believe the strongest relationships are built through knowledge, trust, and consistent
execution.********

**Glycerine is our largest product category**, and we are proud to be one of the largest glycerine
marketers in North America. We actively participate across virtually every grade, specification, and
feedstock source, including both domestic and imported supply. In addition, we maintain a
significant presence in **distilled and fractionated fatty acids, fatty alcohols, and related
oleochemical products**, serving a diverse range of industrial and consumer markets.

At Rierden Chemical & Trading, we combine global market reach, deep product expertise, and local
execution to help our customers succeed—today and for the long term.

VitaminDWiki continues to be the world’s most comprehensive website on Vitamin D. We have >14,400
curated pages of evidence-based studies, overviews, charts, and meta-analyses. ([Click here][5] for

no longer get enough from the sun or their food for optimal health. ([Click here][6] for our video
“Does Less Sun Mean More Disease?” [Click here][7] for 300+ VitaminDWiki posts in Substack)

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

# Culturelle® Medical Advisory Board


Our Microbiome Medical Advisory Board reflects our commitment to leveraging clinical evidence to
deliver microbiome-targeted solutions for your patients. Made up of trusted health care
professionals who truly understand the vital role the microbiome plays in overall wellness, the
Board helps guide our product innovation and clinical development with a focus on rigorous safety
standards and clinical efficacy. The Board is composed of health care professionals with extensive
clinical and research experience who provide strategic expertise across innovation, clinical
development, and medical education.

The Board supports the translation of emerging and established microbiome science into clinically
relevant solutions and contributes to the education of both health care providers and patients on
microbiome-targeted health solutions, with a focus on safety, scientific rigor, and clinical
relevance.

The Microbiome Medical Advisory Board is chaired by i-Health’s Global Scientific Engagement Leader,
Shavon Jackson-Michel, ND.

## Meet Our Board

#### Dr. Shavon Jackson-Michel

##### ND | Board Chair

Naturopathic Doctor and trained, biomedical engineer at the interface of product development,
clinical research and implementation science. Medical affairs and business development leader niched
in advancing researched, natural actives and botanical drugs across commercial pipelines and global
markets.

[ ** READ MORE ][22]

#### Dr. Vivian Asamoah

##### MD, FACG, IFMCP

John Hopkins fellowed and board-certified Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Nutrition expert.
IFM-certified Integrative Medicine practitioner. CEO of Houston Gastro Institute, practicing
physician, researcher, medical consultant, microbiome champion and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][23]

      

#### Dr. Jon Vanderhoof

##### MD

UCLA-fellowed Pediatric Gastroenterologist and researcher with 200+ publications. Chief of Pediatric
Gastroenterology at the Boystown NatResearch Center, attending at Boston Children’s and Senior
Lecturer at Harvard Medical School. Revered industry scientist, probiotics pioneer, and NASPGHAN
past president/awardee.

[ ** READ MORE ][24]

#### Dr. Whitney Casares

##### MD, MPH, FAAP

Stanford University and UC Berkely trained, board-certified Pediatrician and maternal and child
health Public Health specialist. A two-time American Academy of Pediatrics Author and Spokesperson,
private practice physician, consultant and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][25]

## Advisory Board Goals

#### Reinforced Credibility

Our brands have always held a credible standing – buoyed by our science and commitment to quality,
but this board will take this positioning to the next level, reinforcing and extending our reach not
only as a leader, but as an authority.

#### Expert Insights

Our Medical Advisory Board will provide key insights at a closer clip than ever! This fresh angle
will complement the advanced, metrics-driven, consumer-focused data that has always informed our
processes, innovations and positioning—supercharging our successes.

#### Thought Leadership

Holding brands with 20 and 30-year lifecycles, we know that success is a healthy combination of
courage, consistency and continuous evolution. Our boards boast 4x that in combined legacy &
experience, expanding the breadth of our excellence as an industry vanguard for decades to come.

#### Are you a healthcare Professional?

The information on this site is intended for healthcare professionals in the United States and is
not intended for the general public.

# Fortifying Molecules of Life to Prevent Cellular Degeneration

## about us

### Company Overview

BioJiva is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company pioneering the development of first-in-class
therapeutics to treat degenerative diseases resulting from Lipid peroxidation (LPO). BioJiva has
developed a series of oxidation resistant armored Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFAs) as drug
interventions to mitigate LPO.

At the forefront of scientific innovation, our team specializes in lipid biology, natural lipid
peroxidation (LPO) process and its critical role in disease progression. Our first-in-class new
chemical entities (NCEs) are isotopically stabilized synthetic polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs)
designed to mitigate oxidative stress and cellular degeneration caused by LPO, thus addressing the
root causes of various degenerative conditions.

### Mission

With a team of world-class chemists, biologists and ophthalmology experts, we are uniquely equipped
to tackle degenerative eye diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Together, we
are committed to delivering transformative therapies that improve lives.

## Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) is a progressive eye disease and one of the leading causes of
vision loss worldwide, particularly in individuals over 50.

[ » learn more ][20]

Late stage age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) causes central blindness.

##### AMD References

## about us

### Company Overview

BioJiva is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company pioneering the development of first-in-class
therapeutics to treat degenerative diseases resulting from Lipid peroxidation (LPO). BioJiva has
developed a series of oxidation resistant armored Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids (PUFAs) as drug
interventions to mitigate LPO.

At the forefront of scientific innovation, our team specializes in lipid biology, natural lipid
peroxidation (LPO) process and its critical role in disease progression. Our first-in-class new
chemical entities (NCEs) are isotopically stabilized synthetic polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs)
designed to mitigate oxidative stress and cellular degeneration caused by LPO, thus addressing the
root causes of various degenerative conditions.

### Mission

With a team of world-class chemists, biologists and ophthalmology experts, we are uniquely equipped
to tackle degenerative eye diseases, including age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Together, we
are committed to delivering transformative therapies that improve lives.

## Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) is a progressive eye disease and one of the leading causes of
vision loss worldwide, particularly in individuals over 50.

[ » learn more ][20]

Late stage age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) causes central blindness.

### BRX011

BRX011 is BioJiva’s armored version of docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) which enables high visual acuity
and quick adjustment to dim lighting conditions by facilitating instant conformational changes of
the light-capturing pigment rhodopsin embedded in photoreceptor disc membranes. DHA is the most
enriched PUFA in mammalian retinas and extraordinarily susceptible to LPO. There is ample evidence
in the [literature][21] on how toxic oxidation/LPO products interact with complement risk variants
and promote the progression of AMD.

At BioJiva we are dedicated to transforming the landscape of AMD treatment using orally administered
BRX011.

# Cailà&Parés Empresa Oleoquímica

## Fabricación y Distribución de Productos Oleoquímicos

Cailà y Parés S.A. es una empresa oleoquímica con casi 100 años de historia realizando la
**fabricación ** y **distribución de ácidos y aceites grasos** a diferentes zonas del mundo. Puede
conocer más detalles sobre nuestra planta oleoquímica haciendo clic sobre los enlaces inferiores
para comenzar a navegar y conocer más sobre Cailà y Parés, como nuestros productos oleoquímicos, el
cumplimiento de la política medioambiental o conocer alguno de nuestros clientes internacionales.

### Fabricación de Ácidos Grasos fuera del ámbito de aplicación del EUDR (Non-EUDR)

Nuestros ácidos grasos Non-EUDR se fabrican en España utilizando materias primas de origen vegetal
fuera del alcance de la normativa EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). Apostamos por un
abastecimiento responsable y sostenible, priorizando cadenas de suministro trazables y rutas
logísticas cortas dentro de Europa. Gracias al origen de nuestras materias primas y a la proximidad
de la cadena de suministro, contribuimos a reducir la huella de carbono asociada al producto y al
transporte.

### Venta de Ácidos Grasos y Especialidades Químicas para la Industria

Descubre nuestra empresa líder en la fabricación y distribución de productos oleoquímicos de alta
calidad. Ofrecemos una amplia gama de soluciones innovadoras y sostenibles para diversas
aplicaciones industriales. Nuestros [**productos oleoquímicos**][31], derivados de fuentes
naturales, **cumplen con los estándares más exigentes, garantizando eficacia, confiabilidad y
respeto por el medio ambiente.** Colaboramos estrechamente con nuestros clientes para satisfacer sus
necesidades específicas y proporcionar soluciones a medida. Explora nuestra gama de productos y
descubre cómo podemos impulsar el éxito de tu negocio con nuestros productos oleoquímicos de
vanguardia.

Equazen contains only high-quality ingredients sourced from sustainable fish and naturally sourced
primrose oil and borage oil. Our unique formulations provide balanced omega-3 and omega-6 to support
learning difficulties and brain function.

Omega-3 and Omega-6 are essential fatty acids that are vital for good health. Since your body is
unable to produce some of these essential fatty acids, they must be obtained through your diet.  

Each Equazen product has a unique formulation that is beneficial during each of life’s stages. Our
products contain high-quality ingredients that help support development of cognitive functions and
heart health. EPA, DHA and GLA all play an important role in brain development.

We take great pride in our unique Omega-3 with Omega-6 food supplements and use only the best
ingredients and pharmaceutical standard processing techniques, in order to maintain the high quality

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to

As a unique nutrient in the retina, DHA contributes to the normal development of vision. In infants

normal vision.

### PMC Biogenix

# Responsible Chemistry

PMC Biogenix is a global, innovation-driven developer, manufacturer and marketer of specialty
chemicals produced from renewable resources.

The combination of over fifty years of experience developing and manufacturing oleochemical
derivatives, dedication to innovation in new products and chemistries, and strong technical
application support create the foundation of a powerful portfolio of chemical products that find
applications in virtually every chemical end market.

Our products are marketed under our leading brand names such as [Armoslip^{®}][43],
[ADVALUBE^{®}][44], [ADVAWAX^{®}][45], [ADVAPAK^{®}][46], [Hystrene^{®}][47], [Industrene^{®}][48],
[Kemamide^{®}][49], [Kemester^{®}][50], [Kemstrene^{®}][51], [Lubrazinc^{®}][52] and
[Neustrene^{®}.][53]

The [Center for Renewable Chemistry][54], our 3.5 acre technical campus dedicated to renewable
products, provides unmatched product and application development and technical support to our
customers.

[ More About PMC Group ][55]

Our custom solutions are unmatched in the polymers & plastics additives market. Our technical
support team is ready to assist you from concept development to product synthesis.

PMC Biogenix provides a wide range of chemistries for lubricant and fuel manufacturers from both

Our wide range of additives can be tailored to metal working applications in both ferrous and

### PMC Biogenix

# Responsible Chemistry

PMC Biogenix is a global, innovation-driven developer, manufacturer and marketer of specialty
chemicals produced from renewable resources.

The combination of over fifty years of experience developing and manufacturing oleochemical
derivatives, dedication to innovation in new products and chemistries, and strong technical
application support create the foundation of a powerful portfolio of chemical products that find
applications in virtually every chemical end market.

Our products are marketed under our leading brand names such as [Armoslip^{®}][43],
[ADVALUBE^{®}][44], [ADVAWAX^{®}][45], [ADVAPAK^{®}][46], [Hystrene^{®}][47], [Industrene^{®}][48],
[Kemamide^{®}][49], [Kemester^{®}][50], [Kemstrene^{®}][51], [Lubrazinc^{®}][52] and
[Neustrene^{®}.][53]

The [Center for Renewable Chemistry][54], our 3.5 acre technical campus dedicated to renewable
products, provides unmatched product and application development and technical support to our
customers.

[ More About PMC Group ][55]

# Featured Industries


### Polymers & Plastics

Our custom solutions are unmatched in the polymers & plastics additives market. Our technical
support team is ready to assist you from concept development to product synthesis.

[ Learn More ][56]


### Lubricants & Greases

PMC Biogenix provides a wide range of chemistries for lubricant and fuel manufacturers from both
natural and petroleum technology platforms.

[ Learn More ][57]


### Metalworking

Our wide range of additives can be tailored to metal working applications in both ferrous and
non-ferrous environments to meet the most stringent requirements of our customers.

[Learn More][58]


### Chemical Manufacturing

PMC Biogenix produces base oleochemicals and their derivatives from natural, renewable sources for
the global chemical industry.

[Learn More][59]

### Pourquoi choisir Polaris ?

#### Innovation

Polaris est expert depuis plus de 20 années dans le domaine de la lipochimie ou de la chimie des
lipides. L’expertise et la passion de Polaris dans ce domaine en fait un spécialiste de renom, et
plus particulièrement dans le traitement et la transformation des acides gras polyinsaturés par des
procédés de synthèse respectueux de l’environnement.

La spécialisation de Polaris dans la lipochimie se traduit par une forte expertise dans :
* La synthèse enzymatique et la synthèse d’actifs
* Le traitement et la valorisation des lipides: acides gras polyinsaturés

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Les brevets][39]
* [Recherche et partenariats][40]

#### Expertise

Polaris est expert de premier rang au niveau mondial dans les lipides fonctionnels. La société est
spécialiste de la production, du développement et de la formulation des acides gras polyinsaturés et
notamment des Oméga-3. Ses équipes ont développé et mis sur le marché plusieurs innovations visant à
améliorer la qualité, la stabilité et la formulation d’[huiles à haute valeur nutritionnelle riches
en Oméga-3][41].

Polaris a notamment développé un brevet sur l’enrichissement naturel des huiles de poissons riches
en acides gras [Oméga-3 EPA][42] et [DHA][43], ainsi qu’une technique exclusive appelée «
[Qualitysilver®][44]» qui stabilise les huiles polyinsaturées, qu’elles soient d’origine marine ou
végétale. Afin de garantir des huiles de très haute qualité Polaris a également mis en place un
panel de testeur pour assurer à la gamme d’huiles des qualités organoleptiques incomparables.

**Pour aller plus loin :**
* [Qualitysilver®, la stabilité assurée][45]
* [Sensory][46][®][47][, la performance organoleptique][48]
* [Greensilver][49][®][50]

#### Engagement durable

L’OMS recommande à tous, des nourrissons aux personnes âgées de consommer 250 mg d’Omega-3 par jour
pour vivre en bonne santé. C’est pourquoi Polaris s’engage depuis des années pour préserver le
milieu marin en utilisant et valorisant les co-produits de la pêche (têtes de poissons).

Aujourd’hui pour mener à bien cette mission Polaris oriente le coeur de sa stratégie CER vers la
durabilité, en développant sa production d’[huiles de microalgues][51] naturellement riches en
Omega-3, ressource renouvelable et vegan.

**Pour aller plus loin :**

****

As a distributor, importer, and trader of commodity chemicals, our mission is simple: provide
customers with reliable supply, market expertise, and exceptional service regardless of market
conditions. 

We take pride in maintaining a robust global supply portfolio supported by multiple domestic and
international sourcing relationships, supply redundancies, and contingency plans. In an increasingly
dynamic world, our customers rely on us to navigate supply chain disruptions and deliver consistent
results.

At the same time, we recognize that global supply is only part of the equation. Through
strategically positioned inventory across **20 stocking locations throughout the United States and

**. **


 


## Service is our specialty.

****

Our business is intentionally focused on a narrow product portfolio, with **oleochemicals
representing more than 90% of our business**. This disciplined approach allows us to develop deep
expertise in both the products we sell and the markets we serve. Rather than being generalists, we
strive to be trusted specialists and market experts.

Our goal is not simply to execute transactions. We seek to be a valued partner—helping customers
understand market dynamics, navigate volatility, manage risk, and make informed sourcing decisions.
We believe the strongest relationships are built through knowledge, trust, and consistent
execution.********

**Glycerine is our largest product category**, and we are proud to be one of the largest glycerine
marketers in North America. We actively participate across virtually every grade, specification, and
feedstock source, including both domestic and imported supply. In addition, we maintain a
significant presence in **distilled and fractionated fatty acids, fatty alcohols, and related
oleochemical products**, serving a diverse range of industrial and consumer markets.

At Rierden Chemical & Trading, we combine global market reach, deep product expertise, and local
execution to help our customers succeed—today and for the long term.

[USP and NF grade pharmaceutical oil testing, WHC supplies FDA registered food grade and
pharmaceutical grade oils]

compilation resource for public pharmacopoeia standards, encompassing guidelines for medicines,
dosage forms, drug substances, excipients, medical devices, and dietary supplements.

extensive range of products to meet diverse needs including edible and industrial oils.

from food products to ingredients for paints and many other industrial uses.

## Products We Offer

### **USP & NF Oils**

[USP and NF grade pharmaceutical oil testing, WHC supplies FDA registered food grade and
pharmaceutical grade oils]

The United States Pharmacopeia (USP) & the National Formulary (NF) serve as a vital single-volume
compilation resource for public pharmacopoeia standards, encompassing guidelines for medicines,
dosage forms, drug substances, excipients, medical devices, and dietary supplements.

*see [products page][20] for more information.

### **Edible Vegetable Oils**

[Wholesale edible vegetable oils in bulk, USP/NF certified oils, WHC supplies refined food-grade
oils to food manufacturers and pet food producers]

As a well-established leader in the vegetable oil industry, we are committed to offering an
extensive range of products to meet diverse needs including edible and industrial oils.

*see [products page][21] for more information.

### **Fatty Acids**

[WHC wholesale fatty acids and specialty oils, Beef Tallow, Lard, and Coconut Fatty Acid supplier
for cosmetic and soap manufacturing]

As a supplier of high-quality animal fats and fatty acids, we serve a diverse array of industries
from food products to ingredients for paints and many other industrial uses.

*see [products page][22] for more information.

WHC is one of the United States' longest-operating wholesale industrial oil suppliers, providing
food-grade, USP/NF, and specialty oils to manufacturers nationwide since 1838.
